02-on-page-seo.md.title: On-Page SEO
02-on-page-seo.md.description: Module 03 — SEO Deep Dive | Topic 2 --- On-Page SEO means optimising the elements on your own web page to help search engines understand your content and rank it higher. Unlike off-page SEO (backlinks), on-page SEO is 100% in your control. > Simple Analogy: Think of on-page SEO like dressing up for a job interview. You control your outfit, your resume, and how you present yourself. Off-page SEO is like the reference letter someone else writes...

03-technical-seo.md.title: Technical SEO
03-technical-seo.md.description: Module 03 — SEO Deep Dive | Topic 3 --- Technical SEO covers all the behind-the-scenes work that helps search engines crawl, index, and render your website properly. Even the best content will not rank if Google cannot access or understand your pages. > Simple Analogy: On-page SEO is the design of your shop and the products inside. Technical SEO is the plumbing, electricity, and road access that makes the shop functional. If the road is broken,...

04-off-page-and-local-seo.md.title: Off-Page SEO & Local SEO
04-off-page-and-local-seo.md.description: Module 03 — SEO Deep Dive | Topic 4 --- Off-Page SEO refers to everything you do outside your own website to improve your search rankings. The biggest off-page factor is backlinks — links from other websites pointing to yours. > Simple Analogy: On-page SEO is your resume. notes-03.md.title: Module 3: Search Engine Optimization (Deep Dive)
notes-03.md.description: --- Search engines work in 3 stages: - Search engines send "spiders" or "bots" (like Googlebot) to discover new and updated pages - Bots follow links from one page to another - They read the code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) of every page they find - Crawl budget = how many pages Google will crawl on your site in a given time - After crawling, Google stores (indexes) the page content in a massive database - Google decides what the page is about...
